sql: SELECT id FROM (SELECT concept_id id FROM (SELECT c.concept_id FROM concepts c WHERE c.lifecycle_state='active' AND c.visible_to_generation IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_alias_issues i WHERE i.state='open' AND lower(i.proposed_label)=lower(c.canonical_label) AND (i.proposed_type<>c.concept_type OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM concepts d WHERE d.concept_id<>c.concept_id AND d.lifecycle_state='active' AND d.visible_to_generation IS NULL AND lower(d.canonical_label)=lower(c.canonical_label)))))) WHERE id>'' ORDER BY id LIMIT 8
query_plan: SEARCH i EXISTS USING AUTOMATIC PARTIAL COVERING INDEX (state=?)
